text:
liz (product): quick sync — customer asks piling up for Optimize toolbox. main asks: 1) per-route batching hints, 2) KV/prefix caching recommendations, 3) quantization profiles per model family, 4) eval-triggered alerting. can we sketch MVP scope?

mike (eng): +1. suggest we split into infra-safe features vs UX docs. infra: batching heuristics + cache plumbing. UX: recommendations UI and playbooks.

ravi (ml): for quantization, we can ship conservative profiles: fp16, int8-qdq for Llama2 variants, and a compatibility map for plug-and-play. need dataset-driven quality checks before rolling to customers.

siobhan (design): for the recommendations UI — customers want an "Apply" button and an explanation line (cost delta, latency impact, quality risk). tiny non-blocking mock I'm pushing to figma.

jordan (cs): PS from customers: one enterprise wants per-tenant default quant profile + an opt-out audit log. another mid-market wants a ruleset they can override per-route.

mike (eng): constraints: Dedicated infra needs an opt-in flag for auto-quant; we can't silently change serving binary kernels. also batching heuristics need a safety cutoff (max tokens accumulated) to protect latency SLOs.

liz (product): proposed MVP (3-week sprint):
- infra: static batching heuristic + KV prefix cache toggle (no auto-evict policies)
- ml: conservative quant profiles + a sanity regression job (small eval set)
- ux: a recommendations panel with cost/latency/quality bullets and "preview"
- alerts: eval-triggered email/pager rule when quality drops >X% on baseline prompts
Is that too much?

ravi (ml): doable if we limit eval-trigger threshold to a simple comparison against baseline (BLEU/ROUGE not great — use model-specific metric and human-labeled anchor set of ~200 prompts). regression job can run nightly.

mike (eng): engineering ask: need 2 infra tasks up-front: (1) endpoint metadata plumbing (store applied profile + origin), (2) lightweight sim runner to estimate latency/cost for a profile. both are small but necessary for rollbacks.

siobhan (design): UX note: show "confidence" badges for each recommendation (low/medium/high) and a link "why we think this" that expands to a one-line rationale. keeps legal happy.

jordan (cs): prioritization from customers: 60% want recommendations first, 30% want auto-apply, 10% want managed rollout. So MVP should be recommendations + preview, not auto-apply.

liz (product): launch criteria draft:
- recommendations panel live in console
- one quant profile applied successfully to 3 pilot customers with no quality regression >2%
- nightly regression job running and alerting when delta >3%
- telemetry: cost/latency delta visible per-route
If all met -> enable pilot program.

mike (eng): agree. add canary rollout policy: apply to 5% traffic, monitor 1h, rollback if red. we'll wire that into the rollout service.

ravi (ml): +measurements: token-level perplexity shift, top-k accuracy on anchor prompts, and a small human review sample. automate the two metric checks in the nightly job.

jordan (cs): I'll line up two pilot customers (one enterprise, one mid-market) and draft support runbook. need a clear customer-facing doc explaining expected tradeoffs.

liz (product): scope negotiation: what can we cut if timeline slips? options: delay auto-regression alerts (keep nightly jobs but no paging), delay per-route defaults for tenants, or ship only cost/latency preview without the confidence badge. thoughts?

mike (eng): cut preference: delay paging/ops integration first. keep telemetry and recommendations.

ravi (ml): agree. paging is noisy until we tune thresholds.

ops-bot: reminder — deployment freeze next Thu 00:00-06:00 UTC. plan around that for pilot deploys.

siobhan (design): I'll drop the minimal mock by EOD so eng can start wiring.

liz (product): next steps: mike and ravi list infra + ml tickets by EOD, jordan starts pilot outreach, siobhan uploads mocks, i'll draft the launch criteria doc. meeting Friday 10am to sync. Thanks all :thumbsup:
